title: Header, content and footer are already structured for a corporate homepage.
body: The header collapses into a burger menu, the body keeps generous spacing, and the footer is ready for product and company links.
highlights: Sticky glass header with desktop and mobile navigation
Large editorial hero paired with a dark showcase panel
MUI-based components with light and dark theme parity
panelBody: Swap the mocked submit and auth handlers for real API calls without rewriting the layout.
